taxonomyDistinction.TRANSITION_WINDOW_PERSISTENT_EMPTY: HF transition window zero at Run 1 and again at present-day exact replay; recoverability NOT_DEMONSTRATED
taxonomyDistinction.SETTLEMENT_EARLY_AGE_ZERO: Settlement probe zero at scheduledAgeMs=30000 but same query window succeeded at later ages during Run 1; recoverability LATER_IN_RUN_DATA_OBSERVED — not persistent empty
taxonomyDistinction.STRUCTURAL_TERMINAL_TAIL: Session geometry; mandatory maturation horizon falls after session end; recoverability NOT_APPLICABLE_STRUCTURAL — not a recoverable missing-data gap
taxonomyDistinction.OBJECTIVELY_MISSING_BUCKET_TIMESTAMP: A specific bucket timestamp expected inside an otherwise-populated window but absent from provider response; requires per-bucket authority not present in frozen Run 1 evidence

persistentEmptyScope.note: No global PERSISTENT_EMPTY_WINDOW_SUPPORTED; settlement early-age zeros are EARLY_AGE_ZERO_WITH_LATER_IN_RUN_SUCCESS
